description_sq:
Shitet apartament i tipologjise 2+1+2 prane gjimnazit “Ismail Qemali” dhe “Ministrise se Puneve te Jashtme”. 
Apartamenti ka një sipërfaqe totale prej 105 m2, dhe është i organizuar në dy dhoma gjumi, nje dhome ndenjie , dy tualete dhe dy ballkone, nje prej te cilit eshte teper i bollshem se bashku me kendin e gatimit. Banesa ndodhet në katin e katert te një ndertimi të ri 9-katesh, tepër cilësor sipas standarteve te fundit te jetesës. 
Apartamenti ndodhet nje nga zonat me te preferuara ne Tirane duke qene se eshte shume prane Qendres ,Pazarit te Ri , disa Institucioneve Shteterore, Banka, Qendra Tregtare, Shkolla, Kopshte etj.
Për vizitë në apartament na kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 near the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
description_en: 2+1+2 typology apartment for sale, near the "Ismail Qemali" gymnasium and the "Ministry of Foreign Affairs". The apartment has a total area of ​​105 m2, and is organized into two bedrooms, a living room, two bathrooms and two balconies, one of which is extra spacious with a kitchenette. The apartment is located on the fourth floor of a new 9-storey building, very high quality according to the latest living standards. The apartment is located in one of the most popular areas in Tirana, as it is very close to the Center, the New Market, some State Institutions, Banks, Shopping Centers, Schools, Gardens, etc. To visit the apartment, contact us!
